our_text: "Born with no brain" is medically inaccurate. Total brain absence (anencephaly) is fatal within hours/days per Cleveland Clinic. Documented survival cases involve missing brain portions, not complete absence. https://my.clevelandclinic.org/health/diseases/15032-anencephaly
helpful_text: The headline is misleading to be extra shocking for attention. She has hydranencephaly, meaning most of her brain is missing, but not all of it. our_text: The post describes the lights as "mysterious red orbs" but they have been identified as practice jumps by the Denver Broncos' skydiving team using illuminated flares, not unexplained phenomena. https://www.geo.tv/latest/633556-ufo-sightings-over-us-city-of-denver-revealed-as-skydivers-for-nfl-team
helpful_text: Video isn't from "last night" and the lights aren't unexplained. It was filmed Nov 5, 2025, showing the Denver Broncos Thunderstorm skydivers using red flares during a practice near downtown. Flight/ATC data match a skydiving plane in the area.  https://www.geo.tv/latest/633556-ufo-sightings-over-us-city-of-denver-revealed-as-skydivers-for-nfl-team https://www.reddit.com/r/UFOs/comments/1owiqdh/denver_ufo_night_1/
